purpose: Compare a single shared JPY10000 multi-asset paper portfolio against the unchanged ETH rule, with equal maximum entry exposure. Research, not real trading.
universe_limit: Four currently surviving assets selected before this run, not a historical all-coin universe. Survivorship/venue bias remains. SOL unavailable before its listing; require 65 full days before eligibility.
reuse_disclosure: BTC and ETH history has already been researched. These are historical comparisons, not independent unseen evidence. No parameter will be selected using the later period.
multi_one_role: Predeclared historical diagnostic only; do not replace multi_two with a retrospective winner.
capital: Every alternative starts with JPY10000, shared across all its coins. Alternatives are not combined. Reinvest equity changes, no deposits, leverage, shorting, pyramiding, or ranking-driven selling.
entry_rule: Unchanged buffer_momentum_S eligibility per asset: completed 30d return > max(1%,0.5 daily ATR14/price), 4h MA5>20, opportunity/shock/positive volume gates, four consecutive eligible observations, 24h exit cooldown.
ranking: At the decision timestamp rank eligible flat assets by 30d simple return divided by completed daily ATR14/price. Deterministic alphabetical pair tie-break. This is a heuristic, not a predicted return or probability.
selection: Sell existing exits first. Fill previous buy intents in frozen rank order. At execution, size from current shared equity and remaining 25% exposure budget; each new position <=12.5% (multi_two) or <=25% (multi_one). Floor units to venue lot; skip if below minimum. Do not increase allocation to force BTC lot eligibility. No forced rebalancing when price changes make existing exposure exceed25%.
exit_rule: Unchanged: negative half momentum band, max(2% entry price,3*entry 4h ATR) initial stop, max(2%,4*entry ATR) trailing distance, 60d maximum hold. Observe only completed 15m closes; queue for next observed slot.
execution: Signals from completed bars only. Queue at boundary t and execute at t+15min or next observed eligible slot. Historical fills use next 15m open plus synthetic spread and adverse slippage, not same-bar signal-close fills. Buy intent expires after its due slot. No retroactive fills across live monitoring gaps. Fees apply on both sides.
market_rules: Snapshot current bitbank per-asset lot/tick sizes as historical proxies; no reconstructed historical rules. Historical top-of-book depth unavailable. Live comparison checks fresh per-asset orderbooks, spread, capacity and continuous trading mode.
eligibility: No interpolation of missing bars. For any incomplete 65-day indicator window, asset cannot enter; retain marks for valuation, reset its entry confirmations. Existing exits wait for a fresh executable quote. A live run is atomic across four assets; partial collection failure writes an error, makes no trades.
evaluation: Net liquidation value after assumed exit costs; max observed drawdown; fees, closed trips, exposure, minimum-lot skips, yearly returns. Report paired daily differences with descriptive moving-block bootstrap, not selection-adjusted inference.
promotion_gate: No automatic strategy replacement. Primary multi_two must beat ETH in base and stress net return in BOTH historical periods, with MDD <=ETH MDD+2 percentage points and >=20 closed trips per period. Even passing only supports prospective paper testing.
forward: Create a NEW comparison ledger with multi_two and an exact ETH-v1 reference initialized at the same timestamp to JPY10000 each. The existing cloud ETH ledger is left intact. Same collection timestamp and ETH quote for both alternatives. Freeze90days; evaluate >=180days and>=20 completed trips in BOTH alternatives. Record all costs and missed observations. No live-money promotion.
